p.src: A Psalm by David, when he fled from Absalom his son.

en: A Psalm by David, when he fled from Absalom his son.
u.src: A Psalm by David, when he fled from Absalom his son.

p.src: 1  LORD, how my adversaries have increased! Many are those who rise up against me.

en: LORD, how my adversaries have increased! Many are those who rise up against me.
u.src: 1  LORD, how my adversaries have increased! Many are those who rise up against me.

p.src: 2  Many there are who say of my soul, “There is no help for him in God.” Selah.

en: Many there are who say of my soul, “There is no help for him in God.” Selah.
u.src: 2  Many there are who say of my soul, “There is no help for him in God.” Selah.

p.src: 3  But you, LORD, are a shield around me, my glory, and the one who lifts up my head.

en: But you, LORD, are a shield around me, my glory, and the one who lifts up my head.
u.src: 3  But you, LORD, are a shield around me, my glory, and the one who lifts up my head.

p.src: 4  I cry to the LORD with my voice, and he answers me out of his holy hill. Selah.

en: I cry to the LORD with my voice, and he answers me out of his holy hill. Selah.
u.src: 4  I cry to the LORD with my voice, and he answers me out of his holy hill. Selah.

p.src: 5  I laid myself down and slept. I awakened, for the LORD sustains me.

en: I laid myself down and slept. I awakened, for the LORD sustains me.
u.src: 5  I laid myself down and slept. I awakened, for the LORD sustains me.

p.src: 6  I will not be afraid of tens of thousands of people who have set themselves against me on every side.

en: I will not be afraid of tens of thousands of people who have set themselves against me on every side.
u.src: 6  I will not be afraid of tens of thousands of people who have set themselves against me on every side.

p.src: 7  Arise, LORD! Save me, my God! For you have struck all of my enemies on the cheek bone. You have broken the teeth of the wicked.

en: Arise, LORD! Save me, my God! For you have struck all of my enemies on the cheek bone. You have broken the teeth of the wicked.
u.src: 7  Arise, LORD! Save me, my God! For you have struck all of my enemies on the cheek bone. You have broken the teeth of the wicked.

p.src: 8  Salvation belongs to the LORD. May your blessing be on your people. Selah.

en: Salvation belongs to the LORD. May your blessing be on your people. Selah.
u.src: 8  Salvation belongs to the LORD. May your blessing be on your people. Selah.
